content.text: a VMAT-2 inhibitor (tetrabenazine, deutetrabenazine) = typical first-line symptomatic tx of chorea; doses ↑ stepwise as tolerated; avoid w depression (↑worsening depression and suicidality); other SE: excessive sedation, akathisia, parkinsonism; costly; deutetrabenazine appears better tolerated than tetrabenazine.
